title: Daily Drift 3D
description: Weave through sunlit 3D street courses, hit glowing turbo boost pads, merge and upgrade sleek sports cars, and leave rival racers in your slipstream.
controls: Hold and drag left or right to steer across lanes, hit boost pads, dodge traffic, and sprint to first place.

zh-CN.title: 天天飙车 3D
zh-CN.description: 超爽 3D 街机极速狂飙：单手滑动变道踩满氮气加速带，贴身超车甩开对手，合成解锁更猛超跑冲刺冠军！
zh-CN.controls: 按住屏幕左右滑动控制赛车变道与漂移，踩加速带氮气冲刺超越所有对手。
